**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner incorrectly concluded that the Lake Oval was located in the suburb of South Melbourne, rather than Albert Park, despite the initial search results that directly stated the Lake Oval is located in Albert Park (not South Melbourne). The source visited by WebSurfer (Wikipedia in this case) explicitly mentioned "Lake Oval, Albert Park" as the location for the games, but the Planner shifted to assume the suburb was South Melbourne, conflating the home ground of the South Melbourne team (Lake Oval) with the name of the suburb, despite "Albert Park" being provided as the actual suburb. This error was rooted in misinterpretation and a lack of careful attention to the retrieved phrasing.
